propositions: Shell script probe-rebar.sh contains 3 stale assertions against removed flags/keysets and must be ported to Python while preserving continue-on-failure semantics (collect results, report all, exit non-zero if any fail).
All 140 shell assertions must be enumerated and either ported with identical label or retired with documented reason to prevent silent assertion drift.

Shell path scripts/probe-rebar.sh must be retained as a 7-line transitional exec shim because gerrit-verify.yaml executes from MAIN's workflow definition; full deletion blocked until main's golden-path step is re-pointed to Python entry point.

All consumers hard-wiring the shell probe path (test.yml:128, gerrit-verify.yaml:209, anti-rot test substring, docs/releasing.md) must be atomically re-pointed to the Python entry point in the same change.
Side-by-side parity test must confirm identical pass/fail verdicts between shell and Python harnesses on the same build before shell path reduction.
Self-test injection (PROBE_INJECT_FAIL=1) must verify the harness continues past injected failures, reports all sections, and exits non-zero.
